grains.RAW.OUTLETS: one row per remittance agent outlet
grains.RAW.OUTLET_DAILY: one row per outlet per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.AGENT_DOCUMENTS: one row per outlet (agent due-diligence document snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.suspicion_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(confirmed suspicious activity in next 7 days) per outlet, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day network-wide alert-volume FORECAST; split-transfer share ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.INVESTIGATION_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic alert-investigation SOPs (one per outlet type and detection rule); internal policy of a fictional company, not regulatory text
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.AML_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.AML_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, outlet, detection-rule and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (outlets, daily alerts, confirmed alerts by outlet, suspicious-activity risk, transfer events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TRANSFERS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_TRANSFER_ALERT logs new ALERT events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
